title: MIDST Challenge Code Repository
summary: A submission for the Vector Institute MIDST challenge (SaTML 2025) implementing membership-inference attacks against diffusion-model synthetic tabular data generators (TabDDPM, ClavaDDPM, TabSyn). The evaluation pipeline builds SDV metadata objects and calls SDV's evaluate_quality alongside sdmetrics QualityReport/DiagnosticReport/LogisticDetection to score the generated synthetic data.
needs: poetry.lock also lists ctgan and copulas packages but no call sites for them appear in the harvested evidence; unclear if those are actually invoked elsewhere in the repo.
